name: More Than Conquerors
overview: The Scriptures reveal that believers in Christ are assured victory over the trials and tribulations of this world because God is for them, making them more than conquerors. This victory is rooted in God's love demonstrated through the giving of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe. Though the world brings suffering, Christ has overcome it, granting His followers peace amid adversity. By living according to the Spirit rather than the flesh, believers experience life and peace, confident that all things work together for good to those who love God and are called according to His purpose.
